assessment: Parent reviewed the unchanged G1 requirements, verified linked receipt/input/object hashes, and accepts offline G1 for the selected LLVM18 initial route. G2 and hardware execution remain unpassed.

plan_basis.section: 5. G1 — Freeze the compiler and platform contract

implementation_requirements.requirement: Inventory public SDK, packaging, native submission/memory/completion and pinned Mesa boundary; identify reusable and extraction pieces.
implementation_requirements.finding: Pinned PS5 Mesa native boundary and register/completion files are identified; SDK/converter/startup and packaging routes are recorded. Current source is not presented as a qualified Mesa binary dependency.

implementation_requirements.requirement: Inspect provenance before reuse and record dependency URLs, revisions, licenses, build patches, host tools and expected outputs.
implementation_requirements.finding: Lock files, build/package manifests and provenance receipts collectively record these identities. dependencies.json alone is not the full inventory. Ubuntu source-package identity is recorded honestly instead of assigning an upstream Git commit.
implementation_requirements.boundary: Complete archive-member/distribution notice accounting and project distribution-license selection are later release work.

implementation_requirements.requirement: Compare compact standalone LLVM/HIP with corresponding TheRock component build; select one working compatible toolchain and code-object version.
implementation_requirements.finding: Real Clang/LLD24 tools produced by the pinned TheRock component build compiled four fixtures. Stable pre/post executable/library identities resolve the prior observation-time gap. LLVM18.1.8 with AMDHSA V5 remains selected; newer target spelling and resource/ISA changes are explicitly compared.
implementation_requirements.boundary: The full amd-llvm target, including Flang, and staged installation remain incomplete/unverified. The plan asks compiler comparison and one selected working route, not completion of every target or installation of the unselected route.

implementation_requirements.requirement: Compile indexed-store, vector-add and reduction canaries and inspect metadata, entry state, ISA, wave mode, SGPR/VGPR, LDS and private storage; keep first kernel free of prohibited features.
implementation_requirements.finding: Current arithmetic/resource objects and retained metadata/disassembly cover these probes. Frozen indexed-store has zero private/LDS storage and no calls, printf, dynamic allocation or matrix instructions.

implementation_requirements.requirement: Write observed/hypothesized/untested capability contract and explicit initial instruction/metadata boundary; do not equate disassembly with complete validation.
implementation_requirements.finding: Matrix separates observed/implemented facts from untested hardware and rejection boundaries; lists the frozen entry instructions and descriptor/resource fields. Loader structural checks are explicitly distinguished from an arbitrary-ISA whitelist.

implementation_requirements.requirement: Choose dedicated development title and record authorized local hardware environment and coordination protocol.
implementation_requirements.finding: PPSA99014 is selected and locally configured, with idle-only authorization, declared services, exact-title controls and both shared coordination locks. Local addresses are intentionally excluded.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A clean host can reproduce the canaries.
acceptance_criteria.finding: Fresh authenticated Ubuntu packages in isolated userspace reproduced all four complete baseline objects with networking disabled. Current source/recipe/dependency and object hashes were rechecked during this audit.
acceptance_criteria.boundary: Shared WSL kernel and CPU; no second physical machine claim. G1 does not explicitly require a separate physical host.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every requested initial execution-state field has an identified implementation or named blocker.
acceptance_criteria.finding: Initial entry/code window, arguments, reserved private-buffer slots, kernarg s4:s5, group X s6, local X v0, wave32, dimensions, resource registers, FP mode, initialization, visibility/completion and ownership are mapped to implementation and explicit hardware unknowns.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Audited outputs contain no known unsupported feature.
acceptance_criteria.finding: Selected gfx1013 indexed-store entry is scratch/LDS/call-free; its object hash matches the isolated reproduction and frozen package. No known unsupported requested feature was identified in that entry.
acceptance_criteria.boundary: Resource probes with private memory and unselected TheRock objects remain explicitly unsupported/rejected by the initial profile. This criterion does not advertise those research artifacts as launchable.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Normalize recorded nondeterministic metadata or explain it; do not falsely demand byte-identical artifacts.
acceptance_criteria.finding: TheRock replay uses a fresh output path. Pinned driver/AST/CodeGen source explains output-argument-derived CUID symbols. Executable instructions, descriptors and metadata sections match; differences are confined to CUID/symbol/hash/string tables and their sizes/indices. Unmodified whole-object equality remains false.
acceptance_criteria.boundary: Extra explicit-CUID exact-byte diagnostic was inconclusive and is not represented as a pass or added acceptance requirement.

not_required_to_claim_G1: Completed Flang/full amd-llvm build or staged installation of unselected TheRock route
Native GPU execution, throughput or repeated hardware lifecycle qualification
General volatile-private lowering or native scratch implementation
documentation_reconciliation: Status-only documents are deliberately not hashed; parent will reconcile G1 status separately.
Older offline-resource-probes.json has superseded object hashes; use current build reports and isolated reproduction for current artifact identity.
Do not describe full TheRock component or staged installation as complete.
Retain unmodified replay strict_whole_object_equality=false and inconclusive separate diagnostic.
audit_limits: No new console traffic, hardware execution, commit or push
No acceptance-criterion changes; only G1 status is updated after parent review
Existing native test/runtime results are separate from the offline compiler gate
The diagnostic did not reconstruct the original CUID exactly; no general bitwise-reproducible TheRock claim
